layer.fontFaces: @font-face { font-family: Geist; src: url("{{assets}}/bridget_demo/GeistVF.woff2") format("woff2-variations"); font-weight: 400; font-style: normal; font-display: swap; }
layer.css:
[data-ryt="brand"] { color: var(--ryt-text); border-radius: 0px; font-family: var(--ryt-font-body); font-size: 19px; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal; line-height: 1.2; letter-spacing: normal; text-transform: none; text-decoration-style: solid; text-decoration-color: var(--ryt-text); text-decoration-thickness: auto; text-underline-offset: auto; transition: all }
[data-ryt="nav"] a { color: var(--ryt-text); border-radius: 0px; font-family: var(--ryt-font-body); font-size: 19px; font-weight: 400; font-style: italic; line-height: 1.2; letter-spacing: normal; text-transform: none; text-decoration-line: underline; text-decoration-style: solid; text-decoration-color: var(--ryt-text); text-decoration-thickness: auto; text-underline-offset: auto; padding-top: 0px; padding-right: 0px; padding-bottom: 0px; padding-left: 0px; transition: all }
